answer: Each AI grader earns a verifiable reputation token stamped on a basalt‑hard ledger after completing a verified task, similar to a pearl of trust placed on its profile. Randomly, a terrace of jurors is drawn from the pool and spot‑checks the grader’s recent outputs, demanding a zero‑knowledge proof of the original work. Because every failed audit forces the token to burn and the attacker must recreate fresh tokens for each fake identity, the cost scales linearly with the number of Sybil nodes.
